Its persisted executable script has SHA-256 `a83abb7c5be08618c8aaa2d5e2f057b41cb39751e17c5ba83634040c24b0caf7`. - claim-2: This bounded computation does not by itself establish any unchecked all-parameter or parent-theorem claim.
## Strategy
The requested target is **not established**: no task-owned execution supplies the required degrees \(4,\ldots,36\).

The block lemma is proved in the persisted internal certificate at `bdfcc10317a743141f54cb2cc24625a5ded82aedf58aacd4668dd5987d1cd9dc`@L5–L57. Writing selected rows as \([A\ U]\), \(x_r=M[r,D]U^{-1}\in\mathbb Z^{1\times|D|}\), the residual identity gives \(M[r,:]=x_r[A\ U]\). Thus selected rows generate the full row lattice. The unimodular matrix
\[
W=\begin{pmatrix}I_{|B|}&0\\-U^{-1}A&U^{-1}\end{pmatrix}
\]
satisfies \([A\ U]W=[0\ I_{|D|}]\), yielding exactly \(|D|\) unit Smith entries. The map
\[
\pi(b,d)=b-dU^{-1}A
\]
has kernel \(\operatorname{row}_{\mathbb Z}(M)\), so the original \(B\)-coordinate classes freely generate the quotient. For \(D=\varnothing\), \(U=I_0\) and all rows vanish; for \(B=\varnothing\), the quotient is \(0\); both-empty is included.

The missing computation would enumerate
\[
C_d=\{\mu:(2,2)\subseteq\mu\subseteq(6^6),\ |\mu|=d\},
\quad
B_d=\{(2,2,\rho):\rho\subseteq2^4\}\cap C_d,
\quad D_d=C_d\setminus B_d,
\]
construct all \(h_t s_\lambda\) Pieri rows for \(1\le t\le6\), and record \(P_d,U_d,\det U_d\), and all residuals.

## Gaps
Artifact `a847ff26dbd2173b06335b77c00156ee560225ce66071a34e3c4b6f2cb652d8f` checks only degree \(4\); it does not implement or witness the required nonempty degreewise blocks. It records `M_4=[]` rather than explicitly \(M_4=0_{0\times1}\). No executable artifact, complete output, or residual/minor data for degrees \(5,\ldots,36\) is supplied.

Thus the computational block-algorithm capability certificate is missing, and no parent theorem is implied.

## Next
Execute and persist a task-owned exact sparse computation for every \(4\le d\le36\), explicitly including \(M_4=0_{0\times1}\), \(U_4=I_0\), and, in every degree, indexed \(P_d\), full \(U_d\), \(\det U_d=\pm1\), and zero residual checks for every unselected row.
